messages:
support-jen: Harbor (customer) opened a priority ticket — sustained TPS spike caused repeated 429s and increased p99 latency on their dedicated pool. They say it started ~10:05 UTC, still happening. sample error: `HTTP 429 \"token rate limit exceeded\"`

alex: can you paste the gateway logs + the pool id and the model version? also: did they change traffic pattern or deploy a new model?

support-jen: pool: rp-dedicated-42, model: gptx-8k-v2, commit: 2026-02-12. Attach logs snippet from harbor: ``[2026-02-18T10:05:12Z] req id=abc123 tokens=4500 latency_ms=1200 status=200``, ``[2026-02-18T10:05:14Z] req id=def456 tokens=4800 latency_ms=1800 status=429``

infra-ron: looking at runtime metrics now — I see a sustained tokens/s plateau hitting ~28k tps for that pool starting 10:04:50, admission-control started rejecting around 10:05:13. Normal SLO is 10k tps with 2x burst headroom = 20k. So they're above configured headroom.

mike: noisy neighbor? any other tenants on same node showing activity?

infra-ron: yes — two other tenants on the same VM group showed heavy KV-cache churn and long tails on KV miss. One tenant had many small streaming sessions (chatty) — increased batching inefficiency. This reduced effective throughput for the pool.

alex: ok. reproducible steps? support-jen, can you repro from harbor traffic? if they can replay traffic we'd like a minimal script to reproduce tokens/s pattern.

support-jen: Harbor agreed to replay; they're running a replay job now. repro snippet they used: ``for i in $(seq 1 200); do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"gptx-8k-v2","input":"<~4k token prompt>"}' & done``

lisa: sharing immediate mitigations: (1) temporarily raise pool admission headroom to 3x for 15m, (2) enable emergency capacity override to add 2 GPUs to rp-dedicated-42, (3) set gateway rate-limit per-customer to smooth bursts. Which should we try first?

alex: do (3) and (1) in that order. Gateway smoothing is lowest risk. If that doesn't get p99 under SLO, apply emergency override. Also record metrics pre/post. @sre-bot can you annotate the runbook?

sre-bot: runbook annotated: incident-#1826. Added timeline marker at 2026-02-18T10:06:05Z.

infra-ron: gateway smoothing rule pushed: per-key token throttle 12k tps with 100ms token-burst window for Harbor. Admission headroom bumped to 30k tps for rp-dedicated-42 for 15m. Pushing extra GPUs now — ETA ~3m.

support-jen: Harbor reports 429s dropped by ~80% and p99 down from 1.8s to 0.6s after smoothing. They still see a few rejections during the initial 90s while autoscale spins up.

mike: note for postmortem: autoscaler cold-start delay ~2.5m for new GPU attach in that AZ. Need to consider pre-warmed spare capacity or lower spin-up thresholds for urgent customers.

alex: agreed. Action items: 1) infra to investigate noisy tenant KV churn and move heavy chatty sessions to a different VM-group or isolate via qos namespace. 2) product to consider increasing default burst headroom for dedicated plans or exposing headroom config to customers. 3) support to coordinate SOP for emergency override. 4) billing to check if the burst credits mechanism was exhausted for Harbor (could explain why admission controller rejected instead of falling back).

infra-ron: KV churn analysis: tenant B had 5x more short lived streams — I'll open an infra ticket to migrate them. Also adding metric alert for tokens-per-second per-VM to detect this earlier.

support-jen: Harbor confirmed the replay finished and their app is back to normal. They're asking for a timeline and mitigation recap. I'll prepare a customer note once we finalize actions.

lisa: for the customer note include: cause (noisy co-tenant -> reduced effective throughput), immediate mitigations taken (gateway smoothing, temporary headroom bump, emergency GPUs), next steps (isolation plan + autoscaler tuning + optional contract for pre-warmed standby).

alex: last thing — can we add a short repro in the postmortem showing how to simulate admission-control hit locally (small script + how to view `/metrics` to see `admission_rejections_total`)? support-jen, infra-ron please add before closing.

support-jen: will add repro and timeline. closing update to customer planned within 2 hours. :white_check_mark:
